_comment: Curated one-line descriptions for docs/operate/configuration.md, keyed by flag suffix (or full name when unprefixed). Every line here was checked against the reader named in the table. Flags without an entry show the reading function and its docstring instead. Run docs/tools/gen_config_reference.py after editing.
ENV: Declares the environment. `production` or `prod` turns production policy on; `development`, `dev`, `local` or `test` turns it off. Falls back to the unprefixed `ENVIRONMENT`.
ASSUME_PRODUCTION: `1` turns production policy on for a host that does not set `ENV` (bare metal, Kubernetes).
REQUIRE_AUTH: Must be `1` in production. Setting it with `ENV` unset also makes the process treat itself as production.
AUTH_SECRET: Secret that signs session tokens. Production refuses to serve when it is unset or shorter than 32 characters.
ADMIN_EMAIL: Email of the bootstrap administrator. Production needs this pair or `AUTH_USERS`.
ADMIN_PASSWORD: Password of the bootstrap administrator. Set together with `ADMIN_EMAIL`.
AUTH_USERS: JSON array of user accounts, as an alternative to the admin pair.
ALLOW_DEV_USER: Enables a built-in development login. Production refuses to serve when it is on.
SECRETS_KEY: Fernet key that encrypts connector credentials at rest. Required in production.
SECRETS_BACKEND: Where connector secrets are kept: `fernet` (default) or `aws_secretsmanager`.
OTP_PEPPER: Pepper for one-time codes and password-reset tokens. Required in production only when self-serve signup is enabled.
SIGNUP_ENABLED: Master switch for self-serve signup. Off by default; with it off the signup routes answer 404.
TOKEN_TTL_SEC: Lifetime of a session token in seconds.
AUTH_TENANT_BIND: How strictly a tenant resolved from the Host header must match the caller's tenant claim: `strict`, `soft` or `off`. Default is `strict` in production and `soft` elsewhere.
RBAC_UNRULED_ROUTES: What happens to a route with no RBAC rule: `deny` (default) or `allow_and_log`. An invalid value falls back to `deny`.
DATA_DIR: Directory for the service's own state files. When unset, a mounted volume's `data/` folder is used, else `apps/api/data`.
VECTOR_STORE_DIR: Directory for the local vector store.
VOLUME_PATH: Mount path of a persistent volume. `data/`, `uploads/` and `vector_store/` default to folders under it.
MULTI_REPLICA: `1` declares that more than one process shares this deployment. Turns on the topology checks that refuse an unsafe process split, and makes the Mongo job queue mandatory.
PROCESS_ROLE: Which role this process plays: `api` (default), `scheduler` or `worker`. Unknown values are treated as `api`.
SCHEDULE_LOOP: `1` or `0` forces the pipeline cadence loop on or off in this process. Unset: on for the API and scheduler, off for workers.
API_CLAIM_LOOP: Whether the API process also pulls jobs from the queue in claim mode. Default on; set `0` when dedicated workers execute.
WORKER_FLEET: `1` forces claim mode (jobs are queued in MongoDB for workers); `0` forces local mode (the API's own thread pool).
SCHEDULER_MODE: `local`, `claim` or `auto` (default). `auto` picks `claim` when a shared backend is required. `WORKER_FLEET` overrides it.
ACK_BACKEND: Where pending approvals are kept: `file` (one process) or `mongo` (shared). `file` is refused when `MULTI_REPLICA=1`.
WORKER_MODE: Which workloads a worker claims: `batch`, `cdc`, or both when unset.
WORKER_POLL: Seconds between queue polls in the worker process.
WORKER_LEASE_TTL: Seconds a worker's job lease lasts between heartbeats (minimum 15).
API_ORPHAN_RESUME: `0` stops the API from re-queuing orphaned jobs at start. Workers and the scheduler never scan.
JOB_STORE: `memory` keeps jobs in process memory (tests and demos). `mongodb` requires the shared MongoDB backend. Default is automatic.
JOB_ORPHAN_GRACE_SEC: How long a job document must be untouched before the orphan sweeper may settle it. Defaults to the worker lease TTL.
JOB_ORPHAN_MAX_RECLAIMS: How many times an orphaned job is resumed from its checkpoint before it is recorded as failed.
JOB_STEP_STALL_SEC: Default seconds a job step may stay quiet before the job is marked stalled. Past three times this value the job is failed.
ENABLE_DOCS: Serves the interactive API reference at `/docs`. Default on outside production and off in production.
ENABLE_TRACING: `1` turns OpenTelemetry tracing on. Off by default.
CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API.
CORS_ORIGIN_REGEX: An origin pattern set by the operator. There is no default pattern.
WEB_DOMAIN: Public domain of the web app. Added to the allowed origins and used for links.
WEB_URL: Public base URL of the web app, used for links in notifications.
PUBLIC_URL: Public base URL of the API, used for absolute links such as MCP OAuth metadata.
TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT: Number of trusted proxies in front of the API. With N above 0 the client address is taken from `X-Forwarded-For` entry N from the right. Default 0 changes nothing.
HSTS: `1` always sends the HSTS header; `0` never does. Unset: sent when the request is HTTPS or `X-Forwarded-Proto` says so.
EGRESS_ENFORCE_NEW: `1` makes the newer egress checkpoints refuse private and loopback targets. Without it those checkpoints only write an `egress.would_block` audit event.
EGRESS_ALLOWLIST: Extra networks allowed by the egress guard for this process. Intended for local proof runs; leave unset in production.
AUDIT_HMAC_KEY: Key that signs the audit chain. Set the same value on every process that appends audit events.
AUDIT_HMAC_RETIRED_KEYS: Comma-separated earlier audit keys, kept so records signed with them still verify.
AUDIT_ANCHOR_PROVIDER: The anchor provider asked for. Only the local anchor file is implemented: any other value is recorded on the receipt as `requested_provider`, the receipt says the request was not met, and a warning is logged.
AUDIT_ANCHOR_STORE: Path of the audit tip anchor file. Defaults to `audit_tip_anchors.jsonl` in the data directory.
AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS: Days of audit events to keep: `off` (or unset) keeps them, otherwise a whole number from 30 to 3650. Any other value is a configuration error.
EXPOSE_ERROR_DETAIL: `1` appends the redacted exception text to safe error responses. Leave off in production.
PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT: `1` turns on rate limiting for unauthenticated routes. Off by default, including in production.
AUTH_RATE_LIMIT: Login rate limiting and lockout. On by default. Counters are kept per process.
SSO_AUTO_PROVISION: `1` creates an account for an SSO identity on first sign-in, but only for email domains in `SSO_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`. With that list empty no new identity is provisioned (existing accounts still sign in), and the API logs a warning at start.
SSO_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: Comma-separated email domains allowed to sign in through SSO.
DEFAULT_REGION: This deployment's region. The only evidence residency accepts for a local file, SQLite, DuckDB or loopback destination; with it unset those are refused in a workspace with a data region. Also the region `RESIDENCY_STRICT` enforces (`us-east-1` when unset).
DATA_REGIONS: Comma-separated regions a workspace may record.
RESIDENCY_STRICT: `1` enforces `DEFAULT_REGION` as the data region of every workspace that records none. Without it, only workspaces with a data region are fenced.
DEST_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS: Seconds a write session waits for a destination lock before failing (between 1 and 600).
DEST_WRITE_LOCK: Takes one-writer-at-a-time locks per keyed destination table. Off by default.
DEST_WRITE_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS: Seconds a job waits for another job's destination write lock.
PARITY_SIGNOFF_AUTHORITY: JSON object mapping each Trust Report sign-off role to the gate roles (and optionally people) allowed to sign it. A value that does not parse refuses every signature.
VERIFICATION_LADDER_MAX_ROWS: Largest table, in rows, that the in-memory verification ladder compares row by row.
AI_METADATA_ONLY: Keeps cell values out of prompts sent to a model provider. On by default.
CDC_PG_TRANSPORT: PostgreSQL CDC transport: `auto` (default, streaming with a fallback) or `peek`.
CDC_LEASE_BACKEND: Where CDC source leases are kept: `file`, `redis` or `memory`. Unset picks `redis` when a lease Redis URL is configured, else `file`.
MONGODB_URI: MongoDB connection string. Checked first, before `MONGO_URL`, `MONGO_PRIVATE_URL`, `MONGODB_URL` and `MONGO_PUBLIC_URL`.
TRAINING: Runs the background training agent. Unset: on outside production, off in production. Set: only `1`, `true`, `yes` or `on` turn it on; any other value, an empty one included, leaves it off.
SEED_DEMO: Seeds example data at start. The deployment files in this repository set it to `0`.
